INTED DkTE
FPRAL IG, 2028

ORDINANCE

BE IT ORDAINED BY THE CITY COUNCIL OF THE CITY OF CHICAGO:

SECTION 1. Title 17 of the Municipal Code of Chicago, the Chicago Zoning Ordinance
is hereby amended by changing all of the RS-3. Residential Single-Unit (Detached House
Districts symbols and indications as shown on Map No. 8-F in the area bounded:

A line 119 feet north of and parallel to West 37" Street; the public alley next east of and
parallel to South Emerald Avenue; a line 95 feet North of and parallel to West 37" Street;
South Emerald Avenue,

to those of a RT-4, Residential Two-Flat, Townhouse and Multi-Unit District.

SECTION 2. This ordinance shall be in force and effect from and after its passage and
due publication.

Common Address of Property: 3649 South Emerald Avenue, Chicago, Illinois
